verses.text: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Psalm of David. Answer me when I call, O God of my righteousness! You have relieved my distress; show me grace and hear my prayer.

xrefs.text: He has delivered us from such a deadly peril, and He will deliver us. In Him we have placed our hope that He will yet again deliver us,
Then the LORD passed in front of Moses and called out: “The LORD, the LORD God, is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion and faithfulness,
For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. I waited patiently for the LORD; He inclined to me and heard my cry.
They confronted me in my day of calamity, but the LORD was my support.
Turn to me and show me mercy, as You do to those who love Your name.

verses.text: How long, O men, will my honor be maligned? How long will you love vanity and seek after lies Selah

xrefs.text: “How long, O simple ones, will you love your simple ways? How long will scoffers delight in their scorn and fools hate knowledge?
The more they multiplied, the more they sinned against Me; they exchanged their Glory for a thing of disgrace.
But You, O LORD, are a shield around me, my glory, and the One who lifts my head.
You destroy those who tell lies; the LORD abhors the man of bloodshed and deceit.
They exchanged their Glory for the image of a grass-eating ox.

verses.text: Know that the LORD has set apart the godly for Himself; the LORD hears when I call to Him.

xrefs.text: You did not choose Me, but I chose you. And I appointed you to go and bear fruit— fruit that will remain— so that whatever you ask the Father in My name, He will give you.
The eyes of the LORD are on the righteous, and His ears are inclined to their cry.
“Because he loves Me, I will deliver him; because he knows My name, I will protect him.
But we should always thank God for you, brothers who are loved by the Lord, because God chose you from the beginning to be saved by the sanctification of the Spirit and by faith in the truth.
Nevertheless, God’s firm foundation stands, bearing this seal: “The Lord knows those who are His,” and, “Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord must turn away from iniquity.”

verses.text: Be angry, yet do not sin; on your bed, search your heart and be still. Selah

xrefs.text: “Be angry, yet do not sin.” Do not let the sun set upon your anger,
At night I remembered my song; in my heart I mused, and my spirit pondered:
When I remember You on my bed, I think of You through the watches of the night.
Be not wise in your own eyes; fear the LORD and turn away from evil.
“Be still and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted over the earth.”

verses.text: Offer the sacrifices of the righteous and trust in the LORD.

xrefs.text: Through Jesus, therefore, let us continually offer to God a sacrifice of praise, the fruit of lips that confess His name.
Trust in the LORD and do good; dwell in the land and cultivate faithfulness.
Then You will delight in righteous sacrifices, in whole burnt offerings; then bulls will be offered on Your altar.
They will call the peoples to a mountain; there they will offer sacrifices of righteousness. For they will feast on the abundance of the seas and the hidden treasures of the sand.”
Trust in Him at all times, O people; pour out your hearts before Him. God is our refuge. Selah

verses.text: Many ask, “Who can show us the good?” Shine the light of Your face upon us, O LORD.

xrefs.text: Restore us, O LORD God of Hosts; cause Your face to shine upon us, that we may be saved.
may the LORD lift up His countenance toward you and give you peace.’
Restore us, O God of Hosts, and cause Your face to shine upon us, that we may be saved.
Make Your face shine upon Your servant, and teach me Your statutes.
For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Psalm. A song. May God be gracious to us and bless us, and cause His face to shine upon us, Selah

verses.text: You have filled my heart with more joy than when grain and new wine abound.

xrefs.text: You have enlarged the nation and increased its joy. The people rejoice before You as they rejoice at harvest time, as men rejoice in dividing the plunder.
So I have seen You in the sanctuary and beheld Your power and glory.
Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my greatest joy. I will praise You with the harp, O God, my God.
Delight yourself in the LORD, and He will give you the desires of your heart.
For You, O LORD, have made me glad by Your deeds; I sing for joy at the works of Your hands.

verses.text: I will lie down and sleep in peace, for You alone, O LORD, make me dwell in safety.

xrefs.text: When you lie down, you will not be afraid; when you rest, your sleep will be sweet.
I lie down and sleep; I wake again, for the LORD sustains me.
You will be secure, because there is hope, and you will look around and lie down in safety.
I have set the LORD always before me. Because He is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.
He died for us so that, whether we are awake or asleep, we may live together with Him.
